mapper.sql: id, app_id, package_name, channel_code, version_name, version_code, update_mode, min_supported_version_code, policy_revision, title, changelog, download_url, remind_later_hours, apk_size_bytes, apk_sha256, status, publish_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_android_release WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE app_android_release SET app_id=#{appId}, package_name=#{packageName}, channel_code=#{channelCode}, version_name=#{versionName}, version_code=#{versionCode}, update_mode=#{updateMode}, min_supported_version_code=#{minSupportedVersionCode}, policy_revision=#{policyRevision}, title=#{title}, changelog=#{changelog}, download_url=#{downloadUrl}, remind_later_hours=#{remindLaterHours}, apk_size_bytes=#{apkSizeBytes}, apk_sha256=#{apkSha256}, publish_at=#{publishAt}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE app_android_release SET status=#{status}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE app_android_release SET policy_revision=policy_revision + 1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHED'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM app_android_release WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DRAFT'
